origin.description: Permute the code points of each string.
origin.details: The permutation is random. A missing string stays missing.
origin.example: x <- stri_rand_shuffle("abcd"); cat(paste0("stri_rand_shuffle(\"abcd\") keeps ", nchar(x), " characters.\n"))

translation.description: Permute the code points of each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: A string, NA, or a list of those.

translation.details: The permutation is Fisher-Yates with Python's random generator, not R's. A missing string stays NA. The string "NA" is shuffled as text.
translation.value: A list of strings. A missing element is NA.
